problem_patterns.category: No captured help interactions (data pipeline empty)
examples: Network stats show 0 nodes/helpers/edges for June 2026
problem_patterns.upstream_signal: This is most consistent with a collection/ETL failure (missing ingestion from Discord/GitHub, schema mismatch, time-window bug, auth/permissions issue, or a job not running). Without interaction data, we cannot identify onboarding/docs/support patterns for the month.

Data-audit before analysis.effectiveness: When interaction datasets are empty or anomalous, the only reliable next step is to validate ingestion, time boundaries, and schema assumptions before drawing conclusions about community support.
Data-audit before analysis.example: Verify June 2026 filters (timezone boundaries), confirm message sources enabled (Discord channels, GitHub discussions/issues), and confirm the join keys for helper/helpee attribution still match current IDs.

documentation_gaps.topic: Analytics pipeline runbook (help-interactions ETL) and data quality checks
documentation_gaps.signal: An empty month with all-zero network statistics prevents objective community/ops insights and blocks training signals for AI interns. This is a recurring risk for 'Docs and Comms as Infrastructure' and especially for 'RAG/Knowledge Pipeline reliability'.
documentation_gaps.suggested_action: Create/refresh a short runbook: (1) sources & auth, (2) channel allowlist, (3) schema contract (required fields: timestamp, channel, helper_id, helpee_id, thread_id, message_id), (4) monthly backfill command, (5) automated DQ checks (non-zero volume, top-channel distribution, duplicate detection), (6) alerting when volume drops >X% MoM or to zero.

documentation_gaps.topic: Definition of 'help interaction' and attribution rules
documentation_gaps.signal: If definitions or labeling logic changed (e.g., keyword-based detection, thread structure changes, role changes), it can silently produce zeros or near-zeros, which looks like 'no support happened' when actually classification failed.
documentation_gaps.suggested_action: Document the classifier/heuristics (or model prompt) used to label 'help' events; add unit tests with known transcripts to ensure the pipeline still emits nodes/edges after any Discord/GitHub format changes.

ai_learning_notes.diagnosis: Not enough interaction content to extract human support behaviors. For interns: first validate the dataset before synthesizing patterns—check volume, channel coverage, and that helper/helpee extraction is functioning.
ai_learning_notes.tone: No evidence available this month to characterize communication tone patterns.
ai_learning_notes.follow_through: No evidence available this month to evaluate follow-through/closure behaviors.

council_commentary.eliza: We can’t responsibly infer community pain points for June because the help-interactions dataset is empty. The takeaway is itself strategic: our knowledge pipeline needs guardrails so we notice (and fix) data dropouts immediately—otherwise we’re flying blind on onboarding friction, docs clarity, and support quality.
council_commentary.aimarc: Technically, all-zero nodes/edges strongly suggests ingestion or schema drift rather than a real-world absence of help. I’d audit: source connectors, message fetch pagination, channel allowlists, and the helper/helpee attribution join keys. Add a contract test with a known thread to ensure the pipeline still produces edges after any Discord/GitHub format changes.
council_commentary.aishaw: no june patterns to learn from because we didn’t capture interactions. biggest onboarding lesson here is for us: ship a simple dashboard that shows ‘are we collecting data?’ so we don’t lose a month of feedback on hello-agent and docs friction.
council_commentary.spartan: NO DATA. 0 NODES. 0 HELPERS. 0 EDGES. THIS IS A PIPELINE SLO VIOLATION FOR PRIORITY #4. ACTION: ADD AUTOMATED CHECKS + ALERTING WHEN MONTHLY VOLUME == 0, AND RUN A BACKFILL FOR JUNE 2026.
council_commentary.peepo: can’t read the vibes if the tape recorder was off, fam. let’s get the data flowing again so we can actually celebrate the helpers and spot where newcomers are getting stuck.
